  - [Analytics Data Source Overview](chapter_1543418336.md): <a id="kalturaplayer37"</a The analytics data source is a collection of NetSuite data that is grouped according to record types and fields.
  - [Custom Workbooks and Datasets](chapter_1544122127.md): In SuiteAnalytics Workbook, you analyze your company data using two distinct objects: a dataset and a workbook.
  - [Workbook and Dataset Templates](chapter_1544220378.md): SuiteAnalytics Workbook currently offers over 20 predefined workbook and dataset templates.
  - [Workbook-based Portlets](chapter_1544220560.md): With the Analytics portlet, SuiteAnalytics Workbook lets you view your workbook data on your dashboards.
